content.title: Hair-Benefit Proof | Dose, Contact, Smooth Result and Product Return
content.summary: An adult ceramic artist proves a fictional leave-in serum through one measured drop, one application path and one hair-motion result. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject, one fictional product and one fixed hair section establish the comparison baseline. + A visible bounded dose precedes all contact and benefit claims. + The application path remains continuous from hand to the same registered hair section. + The benefit is proven through visible movement and highlights rather than unsupported technical language. + The terminal frame reunites adult face, treated hair, product and one exact original promise.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult ceramic artist with a chestnut bob in a warm studio holding a fictional cobalt bottle labeled exactly "SOFT ARC" beside visibly dry flyaway hair. She presses and draws both hands once from mid-length to the ends of one fixed hair section while the studio window and apron stay registered. Finish with bottle, complete adult face and moving hair together beneath the exact original line "ONE DROP. CLEAN FLOW." without invented scientific claims.
required_anchors: One clearly adult subject, one fictional product and one fixed hair section establish the comparison baseline.
A visible bounded dose precedes all contact and benefit claims.
The benefit is proven through visible movement and highlights rather than unsupported technical language.
The terminal frame reunites adult face, treated hair, product and one exact original promise.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult ceramic artist proves a fictional leave-in serum through one measured drop, one application path and one hair-motion result. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先让同一成年人物与原创护理产品同框，再依次证明用量、手部接触、沿发丝涂抹和顺滑结果；每一步都保留同一房间与发型锚点，结尾回到人物、发丝和产品同框。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject, one fictional product and one fixed hair section establish the comparison baseline.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject, one fictional product and one fixed hair section establish the comparison baseline."

invariants.rule: A visible bounded dose precedes all contact and benefit claims.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A visible bounded dose precedes all contact and benefit claims."

invariants.rule: The application path remains continuous from hand to the same registered hair section.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The application path remains continuous from hand to the same registered hair section."

invariants.rule: The benefit is proven through visible movement and highlights rather than unsupported technical language.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The benefit is proven through visible movement and highlights rather than unsupported technical language."

invariants.rule: The terminal frame reunites adult face, treated hair, product and one exact original promise.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal frame reunites adult face, treated hair, product and one exact original promise."
